Definition: from a derivative of G2357; ceremonial observance:--religion, worshipping.
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, thrēskeía means religion, ceremonial observance. In Acts 26:5, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee. Its 4 occurrences all press in the same direction.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that religion that God accepts is not a show but a life that cares for the fatherless and keeps itself unstained. That is why thrēskeía stays with me long after the verse is closed.
